title: VisualShaderGroup: Reroute node breaks SamplePort data stream
body:
### Tested versions Reproducible in v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878] ### System information Windows 10 - Godot v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878] ### Issue description When passing a `sampler2D` input from a `Texture2DParameter (node)` into the `sampler2D` port of a `Texture2D (node)` inside a `Group (node`), placing a `Reroute (node)` between the `Group Input` and the `Texture2D (node)` breaks the `sampler2D` connection. The `Texture2D (node)` starts acting as if there is no `sampler2D` connected. Without the Reroute (node), the sampler2D works normally and the texture is visible.

The Shader

The Group

The Reroute Node Breaks The Shader.

Look at the preview ### Steps to reproduce - Create a `VisualShader` and add a `Group (node)`. - Open the group. - Click "Edit Ports" on the `Group Input (node)` and add two input ports: set the first input port to "uv" with `Vector2` type, and the second input port to "texture" with `Sampler` type. - Inside group, click on "Edit Ports" on the `Group Output (node)`, add an output port and set it to Vector4 type (for the result). - Inside the `Group (node)`, add a `Texture2D (node)`. - Change the first value of `Texture2D (node)` from "Texture" to "SamplePort". - Connect the uv input of the `Group Input (node)` to the `Texture2D (node)`'s uv port. - Connect the sampler input of the `Group Input (node)` to the `Texture2D (node)`'s `sampler2D port`, using a `Reroute (node)` between them. - Connect the color output of the `Texture2D (node)` to the `Group Output (node)`. - Outside the group, create an `Input (node)` set to UV and connect it to the uv input of the `Group (node)`. - Outside the group, connect a `Texture2DParameter (node)` to the `Group (node)`'s `sampler input`. - Connect the output of the `Group (node)` to the ALBEDO port of the shader's `Output (node)`. - Assign a texture to the `Texture2DParameter (node)`. - The `Texture2D (node)` inside the group now behaves as if no `sampler2D` were connected to it (the shader output stays black/gray). - Remove the `Reroute (node)` and connect the sampler directly, it correctly detects the input and displays the texture. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
